unseen_sampling: same predetermined hash family then map round robin; no score-based selection
condition_E0: forward states repeated to matched total budget
condition_E1: forward plus reversed measured trajectory states
condition_E2: E1 plus conservative multi-positive weak region-text contrastive loss
selection: fixed final epoch 3, no Seen best-checkpoint selection
image_precision: FP16 frozen image transformer + FP32 native masked attention head + FP16 feature storage
text_precision: BF16 frozen text tower; passed FP32 comparison
precision_gate: real observed ROI image/text cosine >= .995 and maximum cosine similarity error <= .01
unseen_gate: positive Seen primary comparison with map-cluster paired 95% CI lower bound above zero; freeze before one formal Unseen run
